overview.description: The Truth Social God Bless America ETF (YALL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides broad exposure to US-listed stocks of various market capitalization. The fund screens out companies perceived to emphasize politically left and/or liberal political activism and social agendas. YALL was launched on Oct 10, 2022 and is issued by Truth Social.
